description: This file contains the implementation of an XML-RPC client and related functions for handling XML-RPC protocol communication in PHP. It includes class definitions for xmlrpc_client, xmlrpcresp, and xmlrpcmsg, along with various functions for XML parsing and encoding. The code facilitates making remote procedure calls over HTTP/S with support for features like multicall, compression, SSL certificates, and cookies.

classes.name: xmlrpc_client
classes.description: Implements an XML-RPC client capable of sending requests over HTTP/S, with support for SSL, proxy, or curl-based communication, including features like compression and cookies.

classes.name: xmlrpcresp
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC response, encapsulating response values, error codes, and serialization functions.

classes.name: xmlrpcmsg
classes.description: Encapsulates an XML-RPC message, including method name, parameters, and serialization methods to generate proper XML requests.

methods.name: xmlrpc_client
methods.description: Constructor for the xmlrpc_client class, initializes server details and configuration for communication.

methods.name: setDebug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug output for sent and received messages.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP Basic Authentication credentials.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Sets an SSL client certificate for HTTPS connections.

methods.name: setCaCertificate
methods.description: Sets a CA certificate or directory for server verification.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets a private SSL key and its password.

methods.name: setSSLVerifyPeer
methods.description: Enables or disables verification of the server's SSL certificate.

methods.name: setSSLVerifyHost
methods.description: Sets verification level for the server's hostname against its SSL cert.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Configures proxy server details.

methods.name: setAcceptedCompression
methods.description: Configures accepted response compression methods.

methods.name: setRequestCompression
methods.description: Configures compression method for sending requests.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to be sent with requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC message, choosing protocol variants dynamically, and returns an xmlrpcresp object.

methods.name: multicall
methods.description: Executes multiple XML-RPC calls as a single multicall request if supported, otherwise fallbacks to individual calls.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Gets/sets the xmlrpc method to be invoked

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns xml representation of the message. XML prologue included

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Add a parameter to the list of parameters to be used upon method invocation

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Returns the nth parameter in the message. The index zero-based.

methods.name: getNumParams
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters in the message.

methods.name: parseResponseFile
methods.description: Given an open file handle, read all data available and parse it as xmlrpc response.

methods.name: parseResponseHeaders
methods.description: Parses HTTP headers and separates them from data.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parse the xmlrpc response contained in the string $data and return an xmlrpcresp object.

methods.name: &parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response data, including HTTP headers, decoding compression if necessary, and XML parsing.
